tips.text: Look for enemies your ally has just hit, then fire Deadly Flourish from far away to root them. Follow up with your own attacks while they are stuck.
Count your four shots. Whisper's last shot always crits and hurts more on low-health targets, so save it to finish a fleeing enemy.
Cast your abilities while you reload. Dancing Grenade is a good way to fill that gap.
Throw Dancing Grenade at a minion next to the enemy so it bounces on to them. It also hits harder when a target dies after being hit.
Put Captive Audience in bushes or on the paths enemies walk, since the trap is invisible. It slows and reveals whoever steps on it.
Use Curtain Call on weakened or slowed enemies. It hurts most against low health, and the cone stays fixed in front of you, so aim before you start.
Don't use Flash while channeling Curtain Call. You can't move or use abilities during it, so start it only when you're safe.

combos.name: Trap into Flourish root
combos.when: When an enemy is in lane or a fight and you want a guaranteed root from range.
combos.text: A trap that blooms on an enemy marks them, so a following Deadly Flourish roots them. Place the trap where they will walk, then fire the long shot.

tips.text: Hit Aphelios with Deadly Flourish right after your support or you land a hit on him; it roots him, so follow up with your next shots.
Aphelios has more range with Calibrum in hand. Stay out of his poke and use Dancing Grenade to trade back when his shot is on cooldown.
Place a Captive Audience trap on the path he walks to trade; it slows him and reveals him.
Finish a weakened Aphelios with Curtain Call as he retreats; it hurts more the lower his health is.
Poke Ashe with Dancing Grenade when she goes for minions; it can bounce to her and extra hits get stronger after a kill.
Land Deadly Flourish on Ashe right after your support hits her, so she is rooted and cannot slip away.
Keep your fourth Whisper shot for when Ashe is hurt; it hits harder the less health she has.
Place Captive Audience where Ashe will step when she moves up, then trade as she is slowed.
Ashe has few escapes, so finish her with Curtain Call once she is low on health.
Stay out of Ashe's Volley, and watch for Enchanted Crystal Arrow whenever you walk alone.
Stay out of Brand's line and dodge Sear; without a first hit his combo can't start, and a stun is deadly.
Do not stand beside your support or minions; Conflagration spreads further onto ablaze targets and Pyroclasm bounces between nearby enemies.
Use Deadly Flourish from long range when Brand has been hit by your support; it roots him so you can hit him freely.
Place Captive Audience in the bush or on Brand's path as he steps up to cast; it slows him and punishes his approach.
Move away from allies as soon as you see Pyroclasm start; its first missile is slow, so you have time to react.
Hit Caitlyn with Deadly Flourish after you or your support damage her; it roots her so you can finish her.
Caitlyn outranges you, so don't stand in front of her minions waiting to last-hit. Use Dancing Grenade on minions to fight back safely.
Watch the ground for Yordle Snap Trap before you walk forward. Stepping on one roots you and sets up a heavy Headshot.
Put Captive Audience where Caitlyn must stand to trade, or on top of her traps. It slows her and then explodes.
Stay behind your minions when Caitlyn fires Piltover Peacemaker; it deals less damage to each target after the first.
Avoid standing in Miasma; it grounds you so you can't dash away. Step out of the clouds quickly.
Walk sideways to dodge Noxious Blast, since it lands after a short delay. Cassiopeia can't safely stay close if you do.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as Petrifying Gaze goes off so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Use Deadly Flourish from long range when Cassiopeia has just been hit by your ally or your basic attack, to root her for a free follow-up.
Place Captive Audience where Cassiopeia will walk to trade; its slow makes her an easy target.
Hit Cassiopeia with Dancing Grenade when she steps up to last-hit; it bounces on to nearby minions and enemies.
Look for Corki's Phosphorus Bomb when you reload. You cannot attack then, so step out of its area and use Dancing Grenade on minions.
Hit Corki with Deadly Flourish for a root after he or your ally has damaged you both. Corki is easy to catch once rooted.
Place Captive Audience where Corki lands after Valkyrie. He is weak after it, so trap the spot he escapes to.
Hold your distance from Corki's Gatling Gun, because it cuts your resistances when close. Hide behind minions only if you can avoid the Missile Barrage splash.
Use Curtain Call on Corki when he is hurt after a trade; it hits harder against low-health enemies and slows him.
Stay patient and poke with Dancing Grenade on minions to hit Draven. Do not walk up while his axes are in the air.
Put Deadly Flourish on Draven after your support or you have hit him. It roots him and cuts off his Spinning Axe catching.
Aim Dancing Grenade or traps at where Draven's axe will land. He loses power when he drops them, so zone him off those spots.
Put a Captive Audience trap where Draven must stand to catch an axe, or in the lane behind you for when he dashes in.
Stay out of Stand Aside's line, since it knocks you back and slows you. Keep minions between you and Draven.
Finish Draven with Curtain Call when he is low, for example as he flees. Be careful once he has many Adoration stacks, since Whirling Death can execute you.
Hit Ezreal with Deadly Flourish after a trap, grenade or ally hit; the root makes him easy to finish.
Place Captive Audience where Ezreal blinks or stands to farm, so he is slowed when he steps in.
Ezreal is fragile, so take the fight when his Arcane Shift is on cooldown and punish him.
Stay behind minions; Mystic Shot stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions block it.
Do not spend all four Whisper shots carelessly; use your abilities while reloading to avoid being poked with nothing to fire back.
Finish a low-health Ezreal with Curtain Call; it deals more the less health he has.
Hit Hwei with Deadly Flourish right after your support or a trap damages him; he is rooted and cannot dodge the next shots.
Place Captive Audience where Hwei will stand to cast. His spells have a long cast time, so he often stays put, and he is slowed when he steps on it.
Hwei is open to attack right after he casts a Torment spell, so rush him with your four shots.
Use Dancing Grenade on Hwei and the minions near him when you want to poke from range.
Keep moving after the trade. His Severing Bolt is slow, so sidestep it, and do not stand still when you are rooted or alone.
Finish a low-health Hwei with Curtain Call when he runs away; it slows him and hurts more the less health he has.
Hit Jinx with Deadly Flourish right after your minions or ally damage her. She gets rooted and can't kite away.
Watch for Jinx's Flame Chompers when you walk forward. Step around them, or trigger her to waste them before you go in.
Fight Jinx while she holds the rocket launcher. Her minigun needs time to ramp up, so jump on her before she switches.
Drop a Captive Audience trap where Jinx will stand or walk. It slows her and reveals her, which sets up your Deadly Flourish.
Use Dancing Grenade on Jinx when she is hurt. A kill makes the next bounce hit harder.
Fire Deadly Flourish at Kai'Sa right after your support or you damages her; she is rooted if it hits.
Put Captive Audience traps in bushes and on her path to your lane; she is slowed and revealed when she steps on one.
Out-range Kai'Sa and poke her with your shots. She is strongest when she gets close, so keep your distance.
Watch Kai'Sa's Plasma stacks; with five on you, Killer Instinct brings her next to you. Stay near your support when she has them.
Don't spend all four shots before she dives in with Supercharge; you can't attack during the reload.
Hit Kalista with Deadly Flourish right after your support or you damage her; she gets rooted and can't dash away.
Drop a Captive Audience where Kalista likes to stand or dash to; the trap is invisible and slows her when she steps on it.
Kalista can't cancel her attack windup. Fire Deadly Flourish or Dancing Grenade when she starts an attack, since she is committed.
Use Dancing Grenade on minions to poke Kalista as it bounces; kills on the way make later hits hit harder.
Step behind minions or into brush to break line of sight; her attacks miss you when she can't see you.
Stay out of Lay Waste range, and stand beside a minion so the blast hits two targets and deals less.
Hit Karthus with Deadly Flourish from long range after your ally or a trap damages him; the root sets up a kill.
Use Dancing Grenade to poke Karthus while he last-hits, since he has little to dodge it with.
Do not walk through Wall of Pain; it slows you and leaves you easy to hit.
Back off and heal before Karthus reaches level 6; Requiem hits you wherever you are, so keep your health up.
Move away from Karthus's corpse once he dies; he can still cast for a few seconds.
Wait until your ally has hurt Kog'Maw, then land Deadly Flourish. The root leaves him unable to escape.
Kog'Maw has no escape, so look for ganks and dive him when his Void Ooze and Caustic Spittle are on cooldown.
Place Captive Audience where Kog'Maw must stand to farm or fight, so he is slowed and revealed.
Do not fight in the ooze left by Void Ooze; stay out of it so you are not slowed.
Run away from Kog'Maw after he dies; his Icathian Surprise explodes shortly after for true damage.
Lucian wins short, fast trades, so stay back and fire Deadly Flourish from long range when a teammate has just hit him; it roots him in place.
Place a Lotus Trap with Captive Audience where Lucian dashes in or walks up; it slows him and shows where he is.
Lucian has strong burst but little sustained damage, so keep your distance and don't stand in front of him after he uses his dash.
Watch your ammo. While Whisper reloads you can't attack, so Lucian will jump on you then; keep Deadly Flourish or a trap ready for that moment.
When Lucian fires a torrent of bullets with The Culling, step out of the line; he can't change its aim once he starts.
Stay out of line with Light Binding. It roots the first two enemies it hits, so keep a minion from standing close to you.
Walk out of Lucent Singularity right away. It slows you inside, and it deals damage when it detonates.
Use Deadly Flourish on Lux after your support or you have hit her. Lux has low health, so the root usually sets up a kill.
Place Captive Audience traps where Lux will step when she goes for Light Binding or tries to escape.
At low health, move sideways when Lux's red Final Spark beam shows. Its range is huge, so it can hit you from far away.
Don't waste your last shot while Lux is shielded by Prismatic Barrier. Wait until the shield fades, then hit her.
Keep the grenade for when Miss Fortune steps up to last-hit. Dancing Grenade can bounce between minions and her.
Hit Miss Fortune with something when she has Strut ready, since any damage cancels her speed bonus.
Place Captive Audience in the bushes or where Miss Fortune walks up to trade. It slows her, and she cannot see it.
Do not stand in Make It Rain, which slows you and cannot be cleansed. Step out of the area at once.
Move out of the way of Bullet Time when you hear her start it. Her cone is narrow, so a sidestep helps.
Keep your distance and poke with Whisper; Nilah has to dash in to reach you, so hit her as she closes.
Place a Captive Audience trap where Nilah will dash or stand; it slows her and reveals her when she steps on it.
Hit Nilah with Deadly Flourish once she is damaged by you or your support; she is rooted and cannot dash away.
Don't spend Whisper's last shot on minions when Nilah is near; save the crit for her.
Do not rely on basic attacks while Nilah has Jubilant Veil up, because she dodges them. Use your abilities or wait it out.
Stay out of Apotheosis range at level 6; it pulls you toward her.
Keep Samira at long range and shoot her with Whisper. She wants to be close, so make her walk into your fire.
Place a Captive Audience trap where Samira will dash in or step. It slows her and reveals her.
Don't expect Deadly Flourish to land when Samira is close to you. She can spin Blade Whirl, which destroys enemy missiles that enter it.
Wait for Samira to use Blade Whirl, then fire Dancing Grenade or Deadly Flourish while it is on cooldown.
Use Deadly Flourish on Samira to root her when she is rooted-ready, after your support or you has hit her. It stops her from diving.
Watch her Style. Once she reaches full rank, back away from her before she can use Inferno Trigger.
Fire Deadly Flourish right after your support or minions' champion damage lands on Senna; she is rooted and can't dodge your follow-up.
Senna out-ranges you once she collects Mist, so don't stand still trading shots with her. Use Dancing Grenade to hit her first and step back.
Drop a Captive Audience trap in the bush or on the path she walks to reach you; she is slowed and revealed when she steps on it.
Senna's Last Embrace is blockable by minions. Stay behind them to dodge it, and keep Whisper's last shot for when she is damaged.
Use Curtain Call to finish Senna or her support when they are low and running away; it hurts more the less health they have.
Wait until Spell Shield is used or on cooldown before you cast Deadly Flourish. Otherwise it is blocked.
Sivir pushes fast with Ricochet. Use Dancing Grenade on the wave and go back to clear it before your tower takes damage.
Step out of Boomerang Blade's path on its way back if it hit you going out.
Place Captive Audience where Sivir chases you. It slows her if she steps on it.
Hit Smolder with Deadly Flourish right after your support or a minion-free poke damages him; it roots him in place for an easy follow-up.
Smolder is weak early, so push your lane advantage and trade with Whisper while he is still stacking Dragon Practice.
Place Captive Audience on the bushes and paths he uses to approach; it slows him and shows where he is.
Use Dancing Grenade on Smolder when he steps up to last-hit; it bounces onto nearby minions and champions that have not been hit.
Step sideways when you see Achooo! start, since it flies far and slows you.
Save Curtain Call to finish Smolder when he is already hurt, since its damage grows as his health falls.
Hit Tristana with Deadly Flourish after your support has damaged her. It roots her for a free trade.
Keep your distance from Tristana and hold back. Your fourth shot hits hard when it lands, but she can jump on you while you reload.
Place a Lotus Trap where Tristana will jump in or stand, such as near your wave. It slows her.
Stay away from Tristana when Buster Shot is up. It stuns you for a moment.
Break the Explosive Charge by stepping away from your minions and allies. Its blast hits everyone around you.
When Tristana has Rapid Fire on, back off until it ends instead of trading.
Keep Deadly Flourish for when Twitch is hit by you or your support; then it roots him, and he is fragile.
Place Captive Audience traps in bushes and at lane edges to punish Twitch when he sneaks in.
Stay out of Venom Cask clouds; they slow you and stack Deadly Venom.
When Twitch uses Ambush and vanishes, play back and watch the lane; he can surprise you with extra speed.
Hit Twitch with Dancing Grenade when he walks up to poke; he has little health.
Keep Dancing Grenade for when Varus is close to minions or in range; it is a short-cooldown poke.
Use Deadly Flourish on Varus right after your support or a minion wave hurts him; it roots him in place.
Sidestep when Varus charges Piercing Arrow; it is a straight line shot you can dodge, and he is slowed while charging.
Drop a Captive Audience trap in the bush or where you retreat; Varus chasing you will slow himself on it.
Don't stand inside Hail of Arrows. It slows you and cuts your healing.
Stay spread out from your support at level 6. Chain of Corruption jumps between nearby champions.
Aim Deadly Flourish at Vayne after you or your support have hit her; the root stops her from tumbling away.
Do not stand with a wall behind you near Vayne; Condemn into terrain stuns you and deals heavy damage.
Place Captive Audience traps in bushes and on the paths where Vayne walks up to trade, so she gets slowed.
Keep your distance when Vayne is close to a third hit; Silver Bolts deals extra damage based on your max health.
Use Dancing Grenade to poke her from range while she is fragile, and back off before she closes in with Tumble.
Walk around Veigar's Dark Matter once you see its marker and hear it; it lands after a delay.
Do not walk through the edge of Event Horizon. Stay inside or step back, since only the edge stuns.
Hit Veigar with Deadly Flourish when he is damaged by your ally or trap; the root leaves him an easy target.
Veigar is fragile and has long range; use Dancing Grenade on him when he is close to minions so it bounces onward.
Place Captive Audience where Veigar must walk to farm or cast; the slow makes his spells easier to hit.
Keep your health high late in the lane; Primordial Burst deals more damage the lower you are.
Wait until Xayah or her support has been hit, then fire Deadly Flourish to root her. Hit from long range, then follow up with your shots.
Don't spend Curtain Call on Xayah at full health, and don't fire it while she is untargetable. Save it for when she is hurt or running.
Plant a Captive Audience trap where Xayah stands to farm or where she walks. It slows her and shows her position.
Use Dancing Grenade on the minion wave to reach Xayah, or to finish a weak enemy. A kill makes the next hit stronger.
Trade while Xayah's Bladecaller is on cooldown. After that she cannot root you for a while.
Do not rely on Deadly Flourish when Yasuo has Wind Wall ready; he can wipe it out. Bait the wall first, then use your other shots.
Place Captive Audience traps where Yasuo dashes through minions; they slow him and punish his approach.
Keep your distance while reloading; Yasuo can close with Sweeping Blade when you cannot shoot back.
Take care when you are knocked up by a Yasuo whirlwind; Last Breath can follow, so stay out of his Steel Tempest line.
Poke with Dancing Grenade when Yunara steps up to last-hit. It has a short cooldown and you can cast it while Whisper reloads.
Hit Yunara with Deadly Flourish right after she or your support has damaged her. She is rooted and can't use her speed boost or dash.
Drop a Captive Audience trap in the bush or on her path when she walks forward. She is slowed and can't easily step away.
Respect her when she turns on Transcend One's Self. Stay back, because her dash and extra attack speed make her fights hard to escape.
Use Curtain Call on Yunara when she is low and running away. It hits harder the less health she has.
Stay out of the way of her prayer bead. Being slowed by it makes you easy to hit.
Hit Zeri with Deadly Flourish right after your minions or support damage her; she gets rooted and cannot dash away or kite you.
Place Captive Audience where Zeri lands from her dash or walks in lane. It slows her and punishes her for sitting in your range.
Zeri is fragile, so use Dancing Grenade to poke her when she steps up for minions. Use it on her only when it will hit.
Save Curtain Call for when Zeri is already hurt or slowed. Her dashes can get her out of the cone, and the shots hit harder on low health.
Trade with your four Whisper shots in order, and hold the last one to hit Zeri. It deals extra damage based on her missing health.
Hit Ziggs with Deadly Flourish after your ally damages him. The root keeps him from dodging.
Do not walk through Ziggs' mines. Hexplosive Minefield slows you and sets up his other spells.
Trade right after Ziggs uses Bouncing Bomb or Satchel Charge. His long cooldowns leave him open.
Place Captive Audience where Ziggs stands to farm or where he will retreat. He is slowed and revealed.
Move around once Ziggs has Mega Inferno Bomb. You can see where it will land, and the center hurts most.
